description.message: Proxy switch for each individual website.

proxy_server_desc.message: Configure your proxy servers, one per line. If a server fails, the next one will be tried automatically.

bypass_domains_desc.message: In global proxy mode, only listed domains connect directly. Supports wildcards like *.cn. Note: Only the domain part is matched; URL paths and query strings are not included in matching.

proxy_domains_desc.message: In on-demand proxy mode, only listed domains use proxy. Supports wildcards like *.google.com. Note: Only the domain part is matched; URL paths and query strings are not included in matching.

mode_system_desc.message: Use the proxy settings of system

mode_global_desc.message: All domains outside bypass list will use proxy

mode_on_demand_desc.message: Only domains in proxy domains list will use proxy
